act_res = primitives.call(
    name="build_vima_pick_place_action",
    source_segmentation_id=6,
    target_segmentation_id=5,
    view="top",
)
if act_res.ok:
    print("Built action:", act_res.output)
    act = act_res.output["action"]
    sub_res = primitives.call(
        name="submit_vima_action",
        pose0_position=act["pose0_position"],
        pose0_rotation=act["pose0_rotation"],
        pose1_position=act["pose1_position"],
        pose1_rotation=act["pose1_rotation"],
    )
    print("Submit result ok:", sub_res.ok)
